rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1986 needs an approved boating education course to run a motorboat or a sailboat.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1986 o después necesita un curso de navegación aprobado para manejar una lancha con motor o un velero.

minAge.note: Motorboat of 10 hp or more: 12+, or younger with a supervisor 18+. PWC: 16+, ages 12-15 with a supervisor 18+, under 12 with a supervisor 21+.

sources.quote: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1986, and of legal age to operate a motorboat or sailboat, must have successfully completed an approved AGFC Boating Education Course to operate a motorboat or sailboat on Arkansas water.

To operate a personal watercraft, a person must be 16 or older, be 12 to 15 years old and be under the direct supervision of a person at least 18 years old, or be under 12 and be under the direct supervision of a person at least 21 years old.
